model_reuse.pilot_crossfit_source_rule: exclude the complete focal validation block from every species-conditioned pilot source feature
model_reuse.heldout_source_rule: all 1275 pilot islands only; no heldout response enters any source feature

P1_primary_overall_increment.estimand: equal-weight mean across 168 heldout blocks of binary_log_loss(C,y)-binary_log_loss(R3,y) over all frozen second-layer island_x_species cells

P2_constraint_signature.absence_estimand: equal-block mean C-minus-R3 among y=0 cells
P2_constraint_signature.presence_estimand: equal-block mean C-minus-R3 among y=1 cells in blocks containing at least one presence
P2_constraint_signature.prediction_absence: absence C-minus-R3 < 0 with block-bootstrap 95% upper bound < 0
P2_constraint_signature.if_below_minimum: P2 presence component is NOT_ESTIMABLE; no threshold or pooling rule may be changed

P3_source_support_signature.graph_source_empty_definition: no graph-reachable occupied pilot source for the focal species in the target bioregion under the actual frozen graph
P3_source_support_signature.estimand: within blocks containing both classes, mean(C-minus-R3 | graph_nonempty) - mean(C-minus-R3 | graph_empty), then equal-weight mean across eligible blocks

P4_topology_specificity.estimand: for each heldout cell, logloss(actual_C,y) minus mean logloss across the 20 rewired-C models; average within block then equally across blocks
P4_topology_specificity.interpretation: evidence that the realized graph adjacency contains information beyond unchanged Euclidean source context and matched degree/edge-length-bin null topology

rewired_graph_null.scope: rewire independently within each of the 12 bioregions
rewired_graph_null.degree_sequence: exactly preserved within bioregion by undirected double-edge swaps
rewired_graph_null.distance_bin_definition: within-bioregion original-edge-length quintile boundaries using type-7 quantiles at 0.2,0.4,0.6,0.8
rewired_graph_null.distance_bin_constraint: every accepted replacement edge must remain in the same original distance bin as the edge it replaces; therefore bin counts are exactly preserved
rewired_graph_null.deterministic_retry_if_disconnected: restart the affected bioregion from the original graph using seed + 100000*retry_index, retry_index 1..20; STOP if no connected null is produced
rewired_graph_null.null_C_fitting: each null graph recomputes only the two graph-path source features, standardizes them from cross-fitted pilot rows, and refits C with the exact frozen ridge method

freeze_before_any_new_heldout_value_deco: actual graph-source-empty mask for all 4126x96 cells
exact null seeds, swap counts, connectivity checks and fingerprints
preconfirmatory_freeze.if_any_model_or_null_fails_before_heldou: STOP; any repair requires a new committed contract and cannot use heldout response

scoring_order_after_prediction_freeze: decode exactly the 96 second-layer species on the 4126 heldout islands once
score P2-P4 without refitting or changing species, blocks, nulls or thresholds
freeze terminal result; no same-lineage rerun after first heldout second-layer value decode

evidence_language.if_P1_supported: prospective preregistered species-layer replication within the same geographic system
evidence_language.if_P1_not_supported: prospective species-layer non-replication within the same geographic system
